name: search_traces
description: Search for OpenTelemetry traces with optional filters (service, operation, duration, LLM provider/model, errors, tags, or generic field filters).

arguments.name: gen_ai_system
arguments.desc: Filter by LLM provider (openai, anthropic, etc.).

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Additional tag filters as key-value pairs.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of traces to return (1-1000).

name: get_trace
description: Get complete trace details by trace ID, including all spans and LLM-specific attributes.

name: get_llm_usage
description: Get aggregated LLM usage metrics (request/token counts) for a time period, broken down by model and service.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of traces to analyze.

name: list_services
description: List all available services in the backend.

name: find_errors
description: Find traces with errors, including extracted error messages, types, and stack traces.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of error traces to return.

name: list_llm_models
description: List all LLM models being used with usage statistics - useful for discovering shadow AI usage.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of traces to analyze.

name: get_llm_model_stats
description: Get detailed performance statistics for a specific LLM model: latency percentiles, token usage, error rates, and finish reasons.

arguments.name: model_name
arguments.desc: Model name to analyze (e.g. gpt-4, claude-3-opus).

name: list_sessions
description: List conversations/sessions grouped by the gen_ai.conversation.id attribute, with per-conversation span counts and token usage.

name: get_session_stats
description: Get detailed statistics for a single conversation/session: span/service counts, LLM request/success/error counts, latency and token percentiles.

name: compare_time_windows
description: Compare aggregated LLM usage metrics between two time windows (e.g. this week vs last week), returning the delta per metric.

arguments.name: range_a_start
arguments.desc: Range A start time in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: range_a_end
arguments.desc: Range A end time in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: range_b_start
arguments.desc: Range B start time in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: range_b_end
arguments.desc: Range B end time in ISO 8601 format.

arguments.name: service_name
arguments.desc: Filter by service name (applied to both ranges).

arguments.name: gen_ai_system
arguments.desc: Filter by LLM provider (applied to both ranges).

arguments.name: gen_ai_request_model
arguments.desc: Filter by requested model name (applied to both ranges).

arguments.name: gen_ai_response_model
arguments.desc: Filter by actual model used (applied to both ranges).

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of traces to analyze per range.

name: get_prompt_version_stats
description: Get aggregated performance stats grouped by prompt name and version (gen_ai.prompt.name/gen_ai.prompt.version).

name: get_llm_expensive_traces
description: Find traces with highest token usage, for cost optimization.

name: get_llm_slow_traces
description: Find slowest LLM traces by duration, for latency debugging.

name: search_spans_tool
description: Search for individual OpenTelemetry spans (not grouped by trace) with optional filters - useful for analyzing specific operations like LLM tool calls.

arguments.name: tags
arguments.desc: Additional tag filters as key-value pairs.

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum number of spans to return (1-1000).

name: list_llm_tools_tool
description: Discover which tools/functions LLM applications are calling, by identifying traceloop.span.kind == tool spans, grouped by tool name with usage statistics.
